title: Vibegraph Manifest Front Matter
description: Schema for the YAML front matter of a VIBEGRAPH.md manifest file, per the Vibegraph Specification v1.0 (https://vibegraph.md/SPEC.md).

vibegraph_version.description: The spec version this vibegraph targets (semver).

owner.description: Display name of the person or organization the vibegraph represents.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the last change to any part of the vibegraph.

default_visibility.description: Default visibility for any item that omits its own visibility. SHOULD be 'private'.

summary.description: Optional one-paragraph orientation a consumer can surface without reading the whole vibegraph.
